card.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
card.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your coat off. The prophecy says this bell-less tower will ring at noon; I need a witness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sign that before you go. We can officially stop waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My watch is five minutes fast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me four more minutes. I'll fill in our names so only the silence needs witnessing.

mechanism: A retains a witness to settle an impossible bell prediction, adjusting the waiting period when the time evidence changes.
confusable: Unlike unbounded magical waiting, A must target a verifiable result and a justified finite revision.
comparison: A fast watch extends the tower vigil by four minutes, distinct from calling the stone prophecy's source about its date.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
